name: Storm Komainu Guardian
loreTies: A shrine guardian lion-dog awakened by tempest vows to hold sacred thresholds against faction trespass.
Guards objective gates and protects support spirits.
source culture humans later copied as Japanese myth and Shinto shrine lore
shortBackstory: Storm Komainu Guardian is a lore-faithful Kami run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Storm Komainu Guardian belongs to The Sacred Kingdoms and exists to express Kami law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Guards objective gates and protects support spirits.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Stone-lacquer komainu with storm cloud mane, gold bell collar, vermilion ward plates. Abilities — Threshold Guard, Thunder Bite, Ward Howl — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
